metadata.name: Radiochemical and geochemical measurements of cryoconite samples from Flade Isblink ice cap, Greenland
metadata.description: Dataset containing radioisotope concentrations (137Cs, 210Pb, 214Pb, 241Am, 207Bi, 228Ac, 7Be, 40K, 238Pu, 239+240Pu) and geochemical properties (LOI, Carbon content) for 48 cryoconite samples collected from the Flade Isblink ice cap in August 2022. Samples were collected at the surface (0 m depth) across a ~3 km x 4 km area with 5-minute temporal resolution during a single measurement campaign.
metadata.spatial: point locations with ~111 m latitude and ~16 m longitude precision
